message.content:
The input structure is described by a primitive-looking skewed cell whose two basal edges share the same length, [[param:cell.a]] and [[param:cell.b]], while the third axis is distinctly longer at [[param:cell.c]]. The two angles involving the long axis, [[param:cell.alpha]] and [[param:cell.beta]], are equal to each other and close to but measurably below ninety degrees, whereas the basal angle [[param:cell.gamma]] is far more acute, near forty-two degrees. This cell contains [[param:input.atom_count]] atoms in total, comprising [[param:composition.N]], [[param:composition.O]], and [[param:composition.Zr]].

Although the input metric superficially resembles a rhombohedral-like setting, the accepted symmetry is the monoclinic base-centered space group number [[param:space_group.number]] (Cm), with Hall symbol [[param:space_group.hall]]. To express the atoms in the conventional monoclinic setting, the input frame is mapped by the basis transformation [[param:frame.matrix]] together with the origin shift [[param:frame.origin_shift]], which is zero; the tiny off-diagonal entries of order 10⁻¹⁹ in the third row of that matrix are numerical residue rather than a real tilt. Input fractional coordinates were rounded to [[param:round_digits]] decimal places.

In the standard Cm setting, every atom occupies the same Wyckoff type: a multiplicity-two position on the mirror plane with coordinate relation (x, 0, z), leaving x and z as free parameters while y is fixed. Thus the whole structure is built from sixteen independent 2a orbits, each generating a symmetry-related partner across the mirror and through the C-centering.

The six zirconium sites are: orbit [[param:orbit.o000.id]], a [[param:orbit.o000.element]] atom at Wyckoff position [[param:orbit.o000.wyckoff]] with free parameters [[param:orbit.o000.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o001.id]], a [[param:orbit.o001.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o001.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o001.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o002.id]], a [[param:orbit.o002.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o002.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o002.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o003.id]], a [[param:orbit.o003.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o003.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o003.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o004.id]], a [[param:orbit.o004.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o004.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o004.parameters]]; and orbit [[param:orbit.o005.id]], a [[param:orbit.o005.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o005.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o005.parameters]].

The four nitrogen sites are: orbit [[param:orbit.o006.id]], a [[param:orbit.o006.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o006.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o006.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o007.id]], a [[param:orbit.o007.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o007.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o007.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o008.id]], a [[param:orbit.o008.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o008.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o008.parameters]]; and orbit [[param:orbit.o009.id]], a [[param:orbit.o009.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o009.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o009.parameters]].

The six oxygen sites are: orbit [[param:orbit.o010.id]], an [[param:orbit.o010.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o010.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o010.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o011.id]], an [[param:orbit.o011.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o011.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o011.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o012.id]], an [[param:orbit.o012.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o012.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o012.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o013.id]], an [[param:orbit.o013.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o013.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o013.parameters]]; orbit [[param:orbit.o014.id]], an [[param:orbit.o014.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o014.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o014.parameters]]; and orbit [[param:orbit.o015.id]], an [[param:orbit.o015.element]] atom at [[param:orbit.o015.wyckoff]] with parameters [[param:orbit.o015.parameters]].

No precision corrections were applied: the listed coordinates represent the structure directly, with no refined deviations to report relative to an idealized backbone.
